name: Fine noodles with grilled pork
summary: Bánh hỏi thịt nướng is the fine rice-noodle sheet VnExpress pairs with charcoal-grilled pork in Châu Đốc. The sheets should be soft, with a thin film of oil. Scallion fat, crushed peanut, and sweet-sour fish sauce finish the bowl. Phong Điền’s bánh hỏi is a different plate.
origin: A Mekong sheet, on VnExpress, 2 Oct 2019, eaten in Châu Đốc with grilled pork.
texture: VnExpress says the sheets are loose and soft, and best with a thin film of oil so the raw flour taste is gone.
howToEat: Eat the sheets with pork that has been marinated and grilled over charcoal. Scallion fat and crushed peanut belong on top.
Sweet-sour fish sauce comes alongside. Pour it over the bowl or dip. VnExpress says some stalls add chả giò and chả cá.
A portion was printed at 25,000 VND on 2 Oct 2019. Check on arrival.
where: Châu Đốc. A street was not printed. Check on arrival.
